en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a man who entered a house of a people without their permission. So their dog injured him. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no responsibility upon them, and if he had entered with their permission, they would have been responsible’.
